enriched.title: How to wear your Galaxy Buds Live for the best sound and fit | Samsung US
enriched.fulltitle: How to wear your Galaxy Buds Live for the best sound and fit | Samsung US
enriched.description:
To get the best sound from your Galaxy Buds Live, make sure you’re wearing them properly. First you’ll want to attach the wing tips to make them fit comfortably. Choose which of the two sizes is best for your ear, and then wrap them around the charging contacts at the top of the buds. Before placing the buds in your ears, check the direction of them to make sure the speaker-end is on the bottom so it will sit at the lower part of your ear. Once inserted, tuck the top half of the bud in the upper part of your ear. Remember not to push them in too far. This can affect sound quality, interfere with the microphone reception, and cause Bluetooth connectivity issues. If the buds continue to go too far into your ear causing reception and connectivity problems, we can provide Galaxy Sleeves to get you a better fit. To request a set of Sleeves, please contact 1-800-SAMSUNG with the model/serial number of your device. Your Sleeves will be shipped within 5 business days.

For more about how to properly wear your buds, including how to attach wing tips: https://www.samsung.com/us/support/answer/ANS00082785/

For instructions on how to attach the Galaxy Sleeves: https://www.samsung.com/us/support/answer/ANS00087422/

enriched.title: How to wear your Galaxy Buds3 for the best sound and fit | Samsung US
enriched.fulltitle: How to wear your Galaxy Buds3 for the best sound and fit | Samsung US
enriched.description:
Great audio starts with making sure your Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 are fitted correctly. For the best sound and fit, adjust your Buds to prevent a gap between your ear and the ear tip. The buds are labeled clearly with L and R markings to indicate left or right. Position the buds into your ears with the L and R facing you and then rotate them until they feel snug. Angle the microphone slightly so that it points towards your mouth. 

Galaxy AI can tailor your sound with a simple setting in the Galaxy Wearable app. Go into the Wearable app. Tap Sound quality and effects and then switch on Adjust sound to fit for pristine audio quality!
